Join Our Team at Mercy Cares Counseling Services, LLC

Are you a dedicated and compassionate mental health professional looking to make a meaningful impact? Mercy Cares Counseling Services, LLC, is expanding and we're seeking talented licensed professionals to join our growing team.

About Us

Mercy Cares Counseling Services is a counseling program which focuses on the whole person (spirit, soul, and body). Clients can expect to be greeted by a warm and compassionate counselor whose greatest desire is to help them overcome the challenges they face so that they can live their best life. Mercy Cares clinicians generally build rapport through creating an environment that is safe and authentic. It is person-centered. It is our endeavor to provide recovery skills from an empathetic, professional perspective to give clients agency over their mental health. This is achieved through psychoeducation, self-care, awareness skills training, and collaboration in the treatment of unhealthy behaviors. Spiritual integration (Christian) is also offered if patients desire.

Current Openings

  • All Licensed Mental Health professionals.

Qualifications and Responsibilities

Therapist Job Responsibilities:

  • Establishes positive, trusting rapport with patients.
  • Diagnoses and treats mental health disorders.
  • Creates individualized treatment plans according to patient needs and circumstances.
  • Meets with patients regularly to provide counseling, treatment and adjust treatment plans as necessary.
  • Conducts ongoing assessments of patient progress.
  • Involves and advises family members when appropriate.
  • Refers patients to outside specialists or agencies when necessary.
  • Maintains thorough records of patient meetings and progress.
  • Follows all safety protocols and maintains client confidentiality.
  • Contributes to practice by accomplishing related tasks as needed.

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible hours; You may choose your own work schedule
  • You may choose to work in-person or virtually
  • ***If you hold a LGPC licensure, your supervision is included***
  • Free CEU’s available to all contractors when opportunities arise.
  • Opportunities for professional development and growth
  • Supportive and collaborative work environment

Qualifications/Skills:

  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Excellent communication and listening skills
  • Ability to build rapport quickly
  • Detail oriented
  • Ability to communicate with compassion and empathy
  • Strong ability to manage time and prioritize tasks
  • Pastoral Counseling experience (not required)
  • Bi-lingual Spanish speaker (not required)

Master’s Education, Experience, and Licensure Requirements:

  • Masters or Doctorate degree in psychology, social work, counseling, or related field
  • Current with all state licensing requirements in the state of Maryland, including LGPC, LCPC, LMSW, LCSW, and Psy. D
  • 2 years’ clinical experience Minimum

How To Apply

If you are passionate about helping clients heal, cope, and thrive, and want to be part of a supportive and dynamic team, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and a cover letter detailing your experience and why you are interested in joining us to mercycares@outlook.com or call the office at 443-741-2457.
